name: 注水控温吸盘辅食碗款
description: 注水控温冬夏皆宜，强力吸盘防打翻，可拆卸内胆易清洗

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating flat pastel panels (mint #C9E6E0, lake blue #63BFD6, blush #F7D4CC, pale mist blue #CDE9F2) and light warm grey #F2F2F0 or white #FFFFFF studio sections, with rounded-corner info cards
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light, front-top key, gentle believable contact shadows, no harsh contrast
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pastel round podiums, white cube plinths, tilted white plank, light-wood table edge
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only; Chinese copy wrapped in 「」, short decorative english caption allowed as small ornament

styleLock.presentationRules: product centered and stable at true-to-reference scale, hero 3/4 angle reused across colorways, stainless inner bowl shown separately for macro
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: soft pastel baby-feeding ecommerce visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of cloud mint #C9E6E0, lake blue #63BFD6, warm off-white #F3F2F0 and blush #F7D4CC with one coral accent #E8746A; warm soft studio mood; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; alternating flat pastel panels and rounded-corner info cards; thin white line icons in outlined pill labels with small heart glyph accents; bright soft diffused studio lighting, front-top key, gentle contact shadows; matte pastel podiums, white plinths and light-wood surfaces; product centered and stable at true-to-reference scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.textZone: top-center two-line headline 「{callout_1}」 in #3F3F3F around 40pt with a small outlined pill badge above it and short subline 「{callout_2}」 below, composed into the upper gradient while the product fills the lower half
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Soft dreamy baby-product mood built to win the first glance. {product} stands at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle on a stacked round pastel podium in the lower half of the frame, full product visible and filling 50-60% of the frame; a small stainless inner bowl filled with colorful baby food leans against the podium beside it. Bright soft diffused studio light, front-top key, gentle contact shadow under both bowls. Layered mint #C9E6E0 and blush #F7D4CC podiums on a soft mint-to-blush gradient backdrop tinted toward #A8D4E4. provenance.notes: 10 片 800×1200 切片（60px 重叠）拼合分析；已剥离店铺会员二维码/「加入会员」水印、装饰英文小字与全部在图文案，温度数值、容量尺寸、材质等级均以 {callout}/{selling_point} 槽位重建，不虚构认证与数据。主产品为注水控温吸盘辅食碗（配 316 不锈钢内胆、双层把手、壶嘴盖），与源文件夹名「宝宝辅食碗」一致，归类按 taxonomy 定为 母婴/喂养 而非源目录「百货」。panel-09/10 中产品图区域在切片里呈纯色圆角块，按版面结构推断为盖体特写位。
